description:
Compute semantic similarity between two specific entities.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table literature_vector — one record = one word2vec embedding of one Open Targets entity ID learned from Europe PMC co-mentions.
Key: word.
Arguments: entity_a accepts literature word or ensembl gene or hgnc symbol or ot disease or disease name or chembl molecule or drug name (resolved; unknown -> error); entity_b accepts literature word or ensembl gene or hgnc symbol or ot disease or disease name or chembl molecule or drug name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Evidence: Similarity means co-mention in the literature, not function, mechanism or causality.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Entities with a literature embedding in OT 25.09; an entity without one was too rarely mentioned.

entity_a.description: Accepts literature_word, ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol, ot_disease, disease_name, chembl_molecule, drug_name; resolved to one literature_word (unknown values are errors, never empty results). The reference entity; excluded from the results.

entity_b.description: Accepts literature_word, ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol, ot_disease, disease_name, chembl_molecule, drug_name; resolved to one literature_word (unknown values are errors, never empty results). The reference entity; excluded from the results.
